what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Russia in the United States: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 49178 Russian asylum seekers in the United States, 55.7% of all asylum seekers from Russia.
Refugees from Russia, a separate group, live mostly in France, Germany and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Russia and Ukraine from 2022 to 2025, and armed conflict over the government of Russia with LSR, RDK and Wagner in 2023 and 2024.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2023 to 2025, fall in the same years as these conflicts.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 2367 asylum seekers.
The figure reached its highest point, 83631, at the end of 2024 and was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for the United States only.
